title: General and performance test requirements of pallet truck and stillage truck
clause_1_scope: This standard specifies the general and performance test requirements of pallet truck and stillage truck.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Hand-Operated Stillage Truck - Lifting Truck (Hand Elevating) - Specification

clause_3_terminology: General and performance test requirements of pallet truck and stillage truck

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
